finalCanvas.explanation:
The central tree retains 72 of the seed's 106 lines: a 32% line reduction and approximately 34% character reduction. Five connected peripherals expand ownership, gesture settlement, rendering dependencies, routing, and external calls. M, O and C describe modular structure, ownership and calls; D remains a cross-cutting computation dependency view. [shared S] identifies the controller's semantic state, with snapshots feeding rendering and checkpoint history supporting navigation.

Only the supplied definition, seed and pinned source text were used. Additional details include copy isolation and selective store publication (canvasWorkspace.ts:42-96; canvasSession.ts:69-105), selection capture and resize policies (MappingEditorRuntime.ts:132-205), projection exclusions and connection focus (shapeProjection.ts:12-51; CanvasRuntimeContext.tsx:88-179), and routing failure recovery (NativeRoutingStore.ts:68-115).

Corrections and qualifications: MappingPage.tsx:468-470 passes every non-hidden draft to the agent bridge, including inactive canvases; 'visible drafts' was imprecise. Saving captures state, synchronizes the document ID, flushes and checks the captured version before publication (912-927); sync is not passed the captured document. An unsupported native clone cancels the entire detected clone batch (MappingEditorRuntime.ts:144-147). Transfer navigation also has a projection-specific path that replaces only the child session (MappingPage.tsx:788-808). Receipt and flush behavior is method-specific: generic apply has no explicit flush in its branch (449-458).

Imported controller, persistence, bridge, worker and layout implementations are not supplied. Their internal guarantees are therefore not inferred beyond the visible calls and contracts. Positions use measured text dimensions with gaps; edge references are 1-based raw ASCII lines.

diagrams.ascii:
Interactive Canvas Runtime
|-- [M] Modular structure: workspace commands <-> semantic state <-> native rendering
|   |-- Workspace orchestration: MappingWorkspacePage + CanvasWorkspace
|   |   |-- Page coordinates active documents, persistence, transfers, agent commands and chat
|   |   `-- CanvasWorkspace exposes draft handles, controller lookup, change and dirty stores
|   |-- Semantic session: CanvasSession -> MappingDocumentController
|   |   |-- Public read surfaces: document, presentation, selection, controls, geometry, status
|   |   |-- Mutations enter through controller commands; mounted and headless sessions share them
|   |   `-- Controller supplies semantic snapshots and checkpoint history [shared S]
|   |-- Native adapter: MappingEditorCanvas + MappingEditorRuntime
|   |   |-- Attaches settle / undo driver to the controller
|   |   `-- Keeps shape reconciliation, checkpoint synchronization and gesture bookkeeping internal
|   `-- Rendering services: CanvasRuntime
|       |-- Exposes per-ID grid, floating-pane, panel and edge models through context
|       |-- CanvasActions callbacks connect rendered controls to application commands
|       `-- Depends on domain layout, local anchors and NativeRoutingStore
|-- [O] State and resource lifetimes
|   |-- CanvasWorkspace owns document sessions
|   |   |-- Draft seed -> new CanvasSession -> new MappingDocumentController [shared S]
|   |   |-- Replaced or removed session -> unsubscribe, remove controller lookup, dispose session
|   |   `-- Workspace disposal -> unsubscribe all, clear persistence listeners, dispose sessions
|   |-- Page retains visited document views across ordinary active-document changes
|   |-- Mounted tldraw Editor owns live shape geometry and native undo navigation
|   |   |-- Semantic document and checkpoint archive remain behind the controller [shared S]
|   |   |-- CanvasRuntime owns transient models, anchors, selection bridge and routing service
|   |   `-- Editor cleanup -> complete and settle -> detach listeners and driver
|   `-- Page hosts supporting resources
|       |-- Chat receives the active session and workspace/document target
|       |-- SourcePaneViewState retains camera and pane-view state; cleanup flushes and disposes it
|       `-- Page-created storage is flushed/disposed on cleanup; injected storage stays externally owned
|-- [C] Runtime calls and checkpoint propagation
|   |-- Mount -> MappingEditorRuntime.hydrate()
|   |   |-- Replay historical checkpoint IDs into native history
|   |   `-- Project current shapes; historical geometry is materialized when navigating
|   |-- Native gesture -> shape/selection observer marks runtime dirty
|   |   |-- While pointing, dragging or pinching -> tick does not settle
|   |   `-- Idle tick -> settle()
|   |       |-- Compare native shapes with the last projected shapes
|   |       `-- Semantic geometry changed -> controller.commitEditorGesture(moves, canvas)
|   |           `-- Controller subscribers publish committed state [shared S]
|   |-- Application command -> controller update -> native publish()
|   |   |-- Same checkpoint while pointer is down -> defer projection
|   |   `-- New command checkpoint -> native history stopping point + shape/checkpoint update
|   |-- Undo/redo -> complete gesture -> settle -> native history navigation
|   |   |-- Changed mappingCheckpoint -> restoreEditorCheckpoint(id) -> reproject without recording
|   |   `-- Transfer boundary -> workspace undo/redo coordinates both participating canvases
|   |-- Camera tick -> captureViewCamera + SourcePaneViewState camera callback
|   |   `-- Overlay follows native camera transform; no semantic checkpoint for each camera frame
|   `-- External boundaries
|       |-- WorkspacePersistence connects workspace changes to storage records
|       |   |-- Explicit save -> capture state -> sync([id]) -> storage.flush()
|       |   `-- Version still matches -> publishMappingCheckpoint -> update captured saved baseline
|       |-- Transfer -> prepare histories/transaction -> storage.save() -> install workspace
|       `-- useAgentCanvasBridge registers non-hidden drafts and dispatches handleAgentCommand()
`-- [D] Computation dependencies: cross-cutting inputs to rendered output
    |-- Projected native shapes = projectMappingShapes([shared S])
    |   |-- Document presentation + diagram views
    |   |-- Display nodes + selection + collapse/visibility rules -> floating shapes
    |   |-- Document edges -> locked arrow shapes
    |   `-- Document alternatives + resolved layout -> locked side-panel shapes
    |-- CanvasRuntime read models also depend on [shared S]
    |   |-- Diagram content, views, cell size, selection and jumps -> per-grid models
    |   |-- Display ancestry + current source content -> pane visibility, stale and missing flags
    |   |-- Semantic edge anchors + resolved diagram layout -> owner-local endpoints
    |   `-- shareEqual preserves equal model branches so unrelated diagrams retain stable values
    |-- Routed edges = native edge inputs + world-space obstacles
    |   |-- Edge definitions + resolved endpoints + native geometry -> nativeEdgeInput()
    |   |-- Content/view/cell estimates or matching measurements -> world-space obstacles
    |   `-- NativeRoutingStore.drawAll(): drag preview, worker queue or synchronous fallback
    `-- Dirty status = current semantic state compared with saved baseline
        |-- sceneDirty <- scene state key differs
        `-- isDirty <- scene differs OR edges differ OR name differs

Session ownership and publication
|-- Registry boundary: CanvasWorkspace
|   |-- setDrafts(document seed) creates a session and controller
|   |-- Metadata-only changes retain the session; updateBaseline refreshes status
|   |-- Replacement/removal unsubscribes, deletes controller lookup, disposes session
|   `-- dispose() unsubscribes and disposes; maps are not explicitly cleared
|-- Copy isolation: copyDocument()
|   |-- Reject hidden/missing/busy source, invalid name or expectedVersion mismatch
|   |-- Clone canvas; clear selection; reset controls; forkHistory(canvas)
|   |-- Retain conversation messages; set thread.pending = false
|   `-- New draft ID and empty savedName; clone captured viewport
|-- CanvasSession read boundary
|   |-- Public stores: getState / getInitialState / subscribe
|   |-- Private backing stores publish controller changes synchronously
|   |-- Document identity change refreshes workspace draft entry for consumers
|   |-- Presentation/selection changes do not take that document-entry path
|   |-- Geometry refreshes on endpointBounds, cell or version change
|   `-- canvasRevisionId change alone triggers onCommit -> changed() + persist([id])
|-- Dirty status depends on saved baseline
|   |-- sceneDirty compares scene state keys
|   |-- isDirty adds edges and name; workspace dirtyScenes uses sceneDirty only
|   `-- Save acknowledgement updates captured baseline; later edits stay dirty
`-- Session disposal clears cursorCopy, controller subscription and commit listeners

Settling native edits into semantic commands
|-- Tick waits until pointing, dragging and pinching stop
|   |-- Dirty shapes/selection -> settle() before any pending projection
|   `-- Pending projection suppresses capture of native drag selection
|-- Compare each native mapping shape with last projection
|   |-- Grid move -> page bounds / cell size -> round and clamp at zero
|   |-- Supported diagram clone -> duplicate-instance with a new copy ID
|   |   `-- Any unsupported clone cancels the entire detected clone batch
|   |-- Floating move/resize -> updateDisplayGeometry + manual placement
|   |   |-- Resize sets fixed sizing; movement retains prior sizing policy
|   |   `-- Collapsed conversation also updates canvasAnchor
|   `-- Commit only when moves exist or display state changed
|-- Selection has two owners
|   |-- Native selected diagrams supply extra drag IDs
|   |-- Application gestures determine semantic content membership
|   `-- Suppressed capture restores native selection without recording history
|-- History navigation
|   |-- Hydrate replays checkpoint references, then projects current shapes
|   |-- Document-meta observer restores changed mappingCheckpoint synchronously
|   |-- Navigation reprojects with history ignored
|   `-- Runtime undo throws at transfer boundaries; page coordinates navigation
`-- Cleanup completes and settles before detaching driver/listeners
    `-- Canvas clears editor reference -> routing.dispose()

Semantic inputs to native shapes and read models
|-- projectMappingShapes(snapshot)
|   |-- presentationScene -> resolveDiagramView -> flattenGrid
|   |-- Cell size maps grid bounds to pixels; default is 8.4 x 18
|   |-- Nested shapes use parent-relative coordinates; root container is locked
|   |-- Floating shapes depend on display visibility and selection
|   |   |-- Skip viewport nodes except conversations
|   |   |-- Skip code-panel and source-code projection shapes
|   |   `-- Collapsed/docked conversations use canvasAnchor and 36 x 36 bubbles
|   `-- Edges and alternative side panels become locked shapes
|-- CanvasRuntime publishes per-ID models in a transaction
|   |-- sync skips unchanged document/display/views/selection/cell references
|   |-- shareEqual reuses equal branches; absent IDs publish undefined
|   |-- Selected content requires region.sourceAscii to match current ASCII
|   |-- layoutKey includes content revision/hash, view, cell, collapse, alternative
|   |-- Float ancestry + source content -> stale, missing and visible flags
|   `-- resolveAnchor subtracts owner grid origin to produce local endpoints
`-- Connection focus depends on semantic identity
    |-- Match displayNodeId + contentNodeId + revisionId for incoming/outgoing edges
    |-- Missing focused edge clears edge focus
    `-- Changed content revision or selection reference clears node focus

Transient routing: geometry, queue and recovery
|-- Obstacles depend on diagram content, view and cell size
|   |-- Matching layoutKey measurements replace estimated local rectangles
|   |-- Native shape page transform maps all four corners into world bounds
|   |-- Missing native shape contributes no obstacles
|   `-- Camera changes are not dependencies; no DOM reads or document writes here
|-- drawAll(native edge inputs)
|   |-- Dragging -> previewEdge using current geometry and last settled routes
|   |-- No worker factory -> synchronous ConnectionRouter.drawAll
|   |-- Matching completed input/obstacle key -> reuse completed routes
|   `-- New key -> replace pending job; preview while waiting
|-- Queue ownership
|   |-- At most one in-flight job plus newest pending job
|   |-- Ignore replies from old worker instances or wrong job IDs
|   `-- Publish only if job key is still requested; then dispatch pending job
|-- Worker failure
|   |-- Terminate worker; disable factory; clear jobs and requested key
|   |-- Queue microtask to publish failure marker outside computed read
|   `-- Subsequent non-drag draw uses synchronous fallback
`-- dispose() terminates worker and clears jobs/completed/settled routes
    `-- Owner/measurement maps remain; sync prunes measurements for absent grids

Workspace persistence and external command boundaries
|-- Explicit save in MappingWorkspacePage
|   |-- Capture document, controller snapshot and name
|   |-- persistence.sync([id]) -> storage.flush() -> recheck captured version
|   |-- Changed version fails before publishMappingCheckpoint
|   `-- Acknowledgement installs captured scene/edges/name as saved baseline
|-- Transfer navigation
|   |-- Ordinary transfer: prepare histories/transaction -> storage.save()
|   |   `-- installWorkspace replaces seeded sessions and increments workspaceEpoch
|   `-- Projection copy is narrower: save child; retain existing sessions/editors
|       `-- Projection undo/redo replaces child only; preserves source archive
|-- Agent boundary receives every non-hidden draft, including inactive ones
|   |-- Reads expose snapshot, identity, nodes or requested revisions
|   |-- Mutations have method-specific busy/version/persistence guards
|   |-- create-diagrams stores receipt before flush; retry flushes without reapplying
|   |-- canvas-generation checks request signature and flushes on retry
|   `-- Generic apply returns cached receipt; it has no explicit flush in its branch
|-- UI visibility and resource lifetime are separate
|   |-- Visited document views remain mounted but hidden when inactive
|   |-- Epoch/reload keys can remount views
|   |-- Chat receives active session/target; copy callback stages cursorCopy
|   `-- SourcePaneViewState cleanup flushes/disposes; owned storage cleanup does likewise
`-- WorkspacePersistence, bridge and controller internals are outside pinned sources
